The record's text (from «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). It was in the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa (#893) until 11-11-2026.
834:
## In short

**Lakṣmīpriyā** was the wife of **Pānuā Gopāla** of **Maṅgaladihi** — the Gopāla who, with her and his sister Mādhavīlatā, served Śrī Śyāmacāṅd when **Dhruva Gosvāmī** (#215) left the Deity in his care.

## Sources

The record's text; the record of Dhruva Gosvāmī (#215).
